nonvacuity: scratch/Check.lean constructs Audit.fairOne : UnitExperiment (Fin 1), with both binary allocations of weight 1/2, and checks its probability law and positive marginals without importing Challenge. This supplies every substantive hypothesis. Fixed y1=2, y0=1 and arbitrary assignment-dependent real f are available in the required types; no independence hypothesis is present.

Closed assertion, with no hypotheses to make vacuous. scratch/Check.lean independently verifies that realTableDesign is normalized and has positive marginals. scratch/numerical_check.py enumerates all 90 distinct assignments and corroborates both opposite-block fits and all ten corrected column entries: SE approximately 0.2470917506, variance 0.06105433321, SD(Vhat) 0.01256670239. This numerical corroboration is not a certified enclosure proof. Existence and uniqueness of each real maximizer also follow mathematically from strict concavity (two distinct covariates give rank two) and coercivity (the displayed positive/negative outcome covariates admit no nonzero weak separating direction); thus the coefficient-choice fallback cannot be used. No independent Lean construction of the transcendental roots was needed.

scratch/Check.lean independently proves that realAsymmetricTwo (FF, FT, TT with weights 1/3) satisfies normalization, positivity of all arm marginals, positive disagreement, and positive off-diagonal same-arm joints. It checks the missing directed joint, and computes in Lean E[Vhat]=23/8 and Var(generalized with f=0)=27/8 for fixed sharp-null outcomes one. Diagonal same-arm joints equal the positive marginals.
